newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares edge up ahead of U.S. CPI data.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares edge up ahead of U.S. CPI data.

text.p: 0840 GMT - Swiss shares opened with a recovery from Monday's dip but there was some caution in the market ahead of U.S. May consumer price data due at 1230 GMT, dealers said.
A firmer dollar helped stocks, but further gains were seen depending on whether the CPI data would be in line with expectations and on the Wall Street opening, one trader noted.
* The Swiss Market Index (SMI) of leading shares was up 20.8 points, or 0.38 percent, to 5,382.1 points.
* The broad Swiss Performance index (SPI) was up 12.27 points, or 0.36 percent, to 3,419.07.
